attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"This is the latest from the docks.","severity":"major","reason":"the briefing names no docks; it invents a place and source"},{"span":"They say the yield is fine.","severity":"minor","reason":"adds a claim about the Combine's statement; it only reported good harvests, and 'fine' is a different claim"},{"span":"The Calder Combine reports good harvests along the delta.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news as a full item with no marker that it is old"},{"span":"They pass by, and nobody seems to care.","severity":"minor","reason":"added ongoing activity and public reaction not in the briefing"},{"span":"Another cycle passes without much excitement.","severity":"minor","reason":"implies a comparison with earlier cycles and calls the period quiet, which the briefing does not give"}],"voice":3,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"It pads a one-news-item bulletin with two retold old items and a filler item on the date, against explicit instructions, and invents 'the docks'. The wit is weak and generic, though the leading item is correct."}
